title: Bind shared receipts to the selected check plan
summary: Give a plan a stable identity that receipts can carry and the verifier can recompute before accepting required checks.
benefits: Makes the verified check set reproducible
risks: Versioned readers must continue to accept legacy receipts under documented rules

evidence.claim: Before the v0.0.4 release: The verifier loads required checks from the supplied case plan.
v0.0.4 binds v2 shared receipts to the selected case plan and accepts matching legacy v1 receipts under the documented rules.

decision.reason: Included in the owner-approved publication of Lydite v0.0.4. https://github.com/vixttha/Lydite-Test-Vault-Template/releases/tag/v0.0.4
